title: IREN Shares Jump as Nvidia Deal Sharpens Bitcoin Miner’s AI Pivot
title_zh: 英伟达交易加强比特币矿工的人工智能支点，IREN 股价上涨
summary: IREN Limited (NASDAQ: $IREN) shares jumped in after-hours trading on Thursday after the company announced a new Nvi...
summary_zh: IREN Limited（纳斯达克股票代码：$IREN）宣布新的 Nvi 后，其股价周四在盘后交易中上涨。

title: New Nvidia deal pumps crypto stock
title_zh: 英伟达的新交易提振了加密股票
summary: IREN Limited (NASDAQ: IREN) shares jumped 27% to $72.28 during after-hours trading on May 7, The move came after the company closed the prior session down 6.77% at $56.85. At press time, the stock had pulled back slightly to $69.45, still up 21.55%.
summary_zh: IREN Limited（纳斯达克股票代码：IREN）股价在 5 月 7 日盘后交易中上涨 27% 至 72.28 美元，此前该公司前一交易日收盘下跌 6.77% 至 56.85 美元。截至发稿，该股已小幅回调至 69.45 美元，仍上涨 21.55%。

title: New Blackstone REIT to offer pure-play data center exposure
title_zh: 新的 Blackstone REIT 将提供纯数据中心业务
summary: Those who live and die by the staying power of the AI boom might soon have a pure-play way to gain exposure to the data center category. Last week, Blackstone filed to debut a brand new data center REIT, the Blackstone Digital Infrastructure Trust ($BXDC).
summary_zh: 那些靠人工智能热潮的持久力生存和死亡的人可能很快就会有一种纯粹的方式来接触数据中心类别。上周，Blackstone 申请推出全新的数据中心 REIT，即 Blackstone 数字基础设施信托 ($BXDC)。

title: KKR Adds Sports Franchise Exposure Through Arctos Buyout
title_zh: KKR 通过 Arctos 收购增加体育特许经营业务
summary: KKR closes Arctos acquisition, adding sports franchise investing and GP solutions to expand its private markets platform.
summary_zh: KKR 完成了对 Arctos 的收购，增加了体育特许经营投资和 GP 解决方案，以扩大其私人市场平台。

title: Diversified, Carlyle strike $1.2bn deal for Anadarko Basin portfolio
title_zh: 凯雷多元化收购阿纳达科盆地投资组合 12 亿美元
summary: The assets span approximately 101,000 acres and produce roughly 300mcf/d net of gas equivalent, comprising 55% gas, 30% NGLs and 15% oil.
summary_zh: 这些资产占地约 101,000 英亩，净天然气当量产量约为 300mcf/d，其中包括 55% 的天然气、30% 的 NGL 和 15% 的石油。
